description: Defines the AudioPlayer class for Android's media framework, including its interface, enums, member variables, and method declarations related to audio playback control.

classes.name: AudioPlayer
classes.description: A class managing audio playback, including starting, pausing, seeking, and setting playback rate, with callback handling for audio data and stream end.

methods.name: setSource
methods.description: Sets the media source for audio playback.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts audio playback, optionally indicating if the source has already started.

methods.name: seekTo
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in the audio stream.

methods.name: isSeeking
methods.description: Returns whether a seek operation is in progress.

methods.name: reachedEOS
methods.description: Checks if the end of stream has been reached.

methods.name: onMoreData
methods.description: Callback for providing more audio data.

methods.name: fillBuffer
methods.description: Fills the buffer with audio data.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the player.

methods.name: getOutputPlayPositionUs_l
methods.description: Gets the current output play position in microseconds.
